report_name: Black Kite 2026 Report: Ransomware Attacks Surge by 24.9%

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: The most prolific ransomware group analyzed in the Black Kite 2026 report, responsible for nearly 20% of all attacks (1,358 victims) between April 2025 and March 2026. The group's activity increased by 443% from the prior year. It operates within a fragmented Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) ecosystem and primarily targets the manufacturing sector in the United States.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Mentioned as the core activity of all ransomware groups in the analyzed period.

attack_patterns.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
attack_patterns.description: Cited as a common technique used by ransomware groups for command and control and data exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Identified as a common initial access vector for ransomware attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
attack_patterns.description: Listed as a frequent technique for lateral movement in ransomware incidents.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Described as a primary method for gaining initial access, either for credential theft or malware delivery.

attack_patterns.name: Financial Theft
attack_patterns.description: Stated as the ultimate objective of ransomware operations through extortion.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Implied through the hunting hint of deleting volume shadow copies using vssadmin.exe to prevent system recovery.

malware.name: Qilin
malware.description: The ransomware used by the Qilin group, the most prolific actor in the reporting period. The malware renames files with extensions like '.qilin'.

tools.name: vssadmin.exe
tools.description: Used by ransomware operators to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b8a1c9d-4e6f-4b8a-a9d8-7c6b5a4d3e2f
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://blackkite.com/reports/2026-ransomware-report
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-24
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects commands used to delete volume shadow copies, a technique commonly used by ransomware to prevent recovery.

indicators.name: Ransomware File Renaming Activity
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware File Renaming Activity
id: 9e3d5c1a-8b7a-4f9c-b1d2-6a5c4b3d2e1f
status: experimental
description: Detects file rename events where files are given common ransomware-associated extensions.
references:
  - https://blackkite.com/reports/2026-ransomware-report
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-24
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    EventType: 'rename'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.qilin'
      - '.lockbit'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects widespread file renaming activity where files are given extensions associated with known ransomware families like Qilin and LockBit.

indicators.name: Ransom Note File Creation
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Ransom Note File Creation
id: f4a3b2c1-d0e9-4a8b-9c8d-7e6f5a4b3c2d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with names commonly used for ransom notes.
references:
  - https://blackkite.com/reports/2026-ransomware-report
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-24
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - 'DECRYPT_INSTRUCTIONS.txt'
      - 'HOW_TO_RECOVER.txt'
      - 'README.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files with names commonly used for ransom notes, indicating a likely ransomware infection.
